id.description: A unique identifier for the folder.

roomId.description: A unique identifier for the room to which the folder should be linked to.

roomType.description:
The room type.
 * `direct` - 1:1 room
 * `group` - group room

driveId.description: Sharepoint or OneDrive drive id. It can be queried via MS Graph APIs.

itemId.description: Sharepoint or OneDrive item id. It can be queried via MS Graph APIs.

defaultFolder.description: Indicates if this is the default content storage for the room.

displayName.description: This should match the folder name in the ECM backend.

creatorId.description: The person ID of the person who created this folder link.

created.description: The date and time when the folder link was created.
